metadata.title: Book an appointment
metadata.description: Choose a service, a date and a time, then send your request. Daw Mi will review it and you will receive an email when it is confirmed.

calendar.dayAvailable: {date}, {count, plural, one {# time available} other {# times available}}

boundary: This is not a crisis service. If you are in crisis, call 000 or Lifeline on 13 11 14, or go to your nearest emergency department.

step1.title: Choose a service
step1.intro: Select the type of session you would like to book.
step1.workshops: Group Art & Wellbeing and Workshops & Programs are arranged by enquiry. Contact us to discuss your project.
step1.loadFailed: We could not load the services right now.

unavailable.title: Service unavailable
unavailable.service: This service is not taking appointment requests at the moment.
unavailable.paused: Booking is not currently available. Please <link>contact us</link> to discuss your options.

step2.title: Choose a date and time
step2.loadFailed: We could not load available times.
step2.noTimes: There are no available times showing right now.
step2.timeLost: That time is no longer available. Please choose another time.
step2.outsideWindow: That time can no longer be booked online. Please choose another time.
step2.serviceChanged: You changed the service, so please choose a time again.

step3.title: Your details

note.label: Short note
note.help: You are welcome to share anything that would help Daw Mi prepare. Please do not include private medical or detailed health information here.

step3.privacyAck: I have read and agree to the <link>Privacy Policy</link>
step3.policyAck: I have read and agree to the <link>Booking & Cancellation Policy</link>

errors.name: Please enter your name.
errors.nameLong: Please shorten your name to 120 characters or fewer.
errors.email: Please enter an email address like name@example.com.
errors.phone: Please use digits, spaces and + ( ) - only, 6 to 32 characters.
errors.note: Please shorten the note to 500 characters or fewer.
errors.ack: Please tick this box to continue.
errors.privacyAck: Please tick the Privacy Policy box to continue.
errors.policyAck: Please tick the Booking & Cancellation Policy box to continue.

step4.title: Review your request
step4.intro: Please check the details before sending your request.
step4.notice: Please note: This is a request, not a confirmed booking. Daw Mi will be in touch to confirm your appointment.
step4.noticeInstant: Please note: Your appointment is booked as soon as you send this. You will receive a confirmation email.

failed.title: Your request was not sent.
failed.text: No appointment request was created. Your details are still here, so you can try again.

step4.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
step4.rateLimitedFor: Too many attempts. Please wait {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}} and try again.

pending.title: Appointment request received
pending.text: Daw Mi will review your request and you will receive an email when it is confirmed.

confirmed.title: Your appointment is confirmed.
confirmed.text: A confirmation email is on its way with the details and how to join.

pending.email: You receive an email when it is confirmed.
pending.join: The email explains how to join your online session.

confirmed.email: Check your email for the confirmation.
confirmed.manage: Use the link in the email if you need to change or cancel.
confirmed.join: Join your online session from the link at the appointment time.
